claims.assertion: Swaruu says a ship's computer maps destination frequencies and its high-energy toroid matches the vessel to them, enabling instantaneous superluminal jumps across space and time.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says large Taygetan ships use gravitational, plasma-jet, and toroidal flight systems as needed; multiple systems allow a damaged vessel to land.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu says Suzy craft can enter hyperspace while stationary and remain undetectable and invulnerable, enabling surveillance, extraction, wall passage, and attacks; other races have not replicated this.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She attributes the capabilities to static hyperspace mode.
